name: Suez
verdict: SUEZ S.A. is 97% owned by SUEZ Holding, held by Meridiam (40%), GIP (40%) and Caisse des Dépôts and CNP Assurances (20%), with 3% held by employees. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: co-title sponsor of FDJ United-Suez. Caisse des Dépôts (with CNP Assurances) holds 20% of SUEZ Holding (which owns 97% of SUEZ S.A.; about 18.8% effective per SUEZ's governance-page chart) and is described by SUEZ as 'a French public-sector financial institution' — a French-state link of more than 5%, but France doesn't count as a record under METHOD.md (maintainer decision of September 2026, for Renault: findings of excessive police force and racial profiling are not a record of this kind), so the rating is none. Source disagreement: Cyclist (July 2025 snapshot) calls Suez 'listed on the Paris and Brussels Euronext exchanges', while SUEZ's own financial statements and governance page present a private consortium holding via SUEZ Holding; the company's own documents are treated as authoritative.
